purpose: Pass10 bounded typographic challenge of six remaining additions dagesh notes on shin/sin/gimel. Exact literal proposals only.
canonicalApplicationState: Report author made no canonical edits. All three canonical source files remain byte-identical to stable Pass10 baseline599; root integrates approved proposals separately.
sourcePolicy: Original embedded A2 image pixels only, with native crops and integer nearest-neighbor enlargements. No OCR, inferred spelling, grammar, normalization, filtering, reconstruction or another translation. A bridged point may be read only where the complete distinctive added-node contour discriminates from the ordinary arm/stem/foot and matches literal pointed controls. Clean cavity alone does not establish absence when the point could merge into a normal stroke.
scope: Six selected sites in already annotated chapters. Same-page/same-unit unmarked letter shapes and literal pointed/plain controls from the same A2 printing font supply comparison. All WIS control chapters remain annotated. No new PDF exports or source catalog changes.

decisions.finding: A compact rounded lobe projects rightward from the still-continuing middle diagonal, below the shin head and above the ordinary base. Its size, position and outline match the genuinely detached same-A2-font WIS13:2 shin point. The same-verse shin in והושיע has a thin continuous middle diagonal and no rightward node. The added interior contour is diagnostic despite its narrow attachment.

independentApproval.basis: Each exact target/fullword/numbered context and relevant detached pointed/plain same-font controls independently viewed before approval.

decisions.finding: The middle shin diagonal continues down-left while a compact rounded lobe protrudes to its right inside the lower cavity, leaving a distinct white notch below it. It matches the detached WIS13:2 interior point in position/size and differs from the thin ordinary arm in same-page כאשר. The protrusion is an added interior node above the ordinary base, not an enlarged lower foot.

decisions.finding: A compact round leftward node lies below the gimel head and well above its normal lower diagonal foot. A narrow bridge to the continuing right stem/head leaves a small upper white window. This added mid-stem contour matches detached WIS13:8 גם gimel point; the same-unit local הרג and WIS9:16 נשיג controls show only the ordinary thin stem and lower foot.

Its outline/placement matches the detached WIS13:2 point and differs from same-page plain כאשר. The preceding approved Pass9 tsere has already changed this anchor to בִשֵׁל; that pre-existing C1-before-B5 scalar order is preserved exactly.

decisions.finding: The sin base letter has an added compact rounded rightward lobe from its still-continuing middle diagonal, in the lower interior above the ordinary foot. Its position and shape match the pointed shin control, whose base letterform is the same; local and same-A2-font plain arms lack this protrusion. The separate dot over the left head is preserved and is not the mark being supplied.

decisions.finding: The shin middle arm has no diagnostic additional rounded node, but its ordinary thick stroke can absorb an interior point. The clean-looking cavity and similarity to a local plain אשר cannot certify literal absence where a point could coincide with the normal arm. Retain the existing uncertainty; no point is supplied or declared absent.

preservationContract: Insert exactly one U+05BC per approved word and preserve every pre-existing scalar in relative order.
BEL33 retains the existing shin C1-before-B5 order from Pass9, adding BC after those existing marks without normalization.
Retire only the five approved IDs and refresh anchors only for retained notes sharing the changed words.
Preserve all consonants, existing vowels, punctuation, witness labels, brackets, gaps, blocks, chapter/verse order and Catholic chapter-return decisions.
ESG uncertainty remains; no dagesh absence is certified.
